cards.prose: The seventy come back glad that even the devils obey them, and Yahusha (Jesus) says he beheld Satan fall as lightning from heaven. Daniel's verse says what is let to run in the earth meanwhile: great words against the El Elyon (most High), the saints worn out, times and laws changed, for *a time and times and the dividing of time*. The next verse says the judgment sits and his dominion is taken away.
cards.member_phrase: shall wear out the saints of the El Elyon (most High), and think to change times and laws
cards.member_sentence: Daniel's verse says what is let to run for a set time: great words against the El Elyon (most High), the saints worn out, times and laws changed.
cards.flag: Old note reads this through the Watcher rebellion; neither verse says that, so I set Luke and Daniel side by side without naming who Daniel's horn is.
